title: Nutriband Inc. Shares Interview with Chairman Serguei Melnik from NobleCon21
summary: Nutriband Inc. Chairman and Founder Serguei Melnik recently participated in an interview at the Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Conference (NobleCon21), where he discussed the Company’s business model, proprietary AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent technology, FDA regulatory pathway, and upcoming milestones.The full interview is available for viewing below and provides additional insight into Nutriband’s strategy, market opportunity, and progress toward commercialization.Serguei Melnik at NobleCon21
body_markdown:
Nutriband Inc. Chairman and Founder Serguei Melnik recently participated in an interview at the Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Conference (NobleCon21), where he discussed the Company’s business model, proprietary AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent technology, FDA regulatory pathway, and upcoming milestones.


The full interview is available for viewing below and provides additional insight into Nutriband’s strategy, market opportunity, and progress toward commercialization.
